context.problem_statement: Perform a fairness audit on a loan approval model. Compute demographic parity for protected attributes: 'gender' (Male/Female) and 'race' (White/Non-White). Demographic parity requires that approval rates are equal across groups. Compute: (1) approval rate per group, (2) demographic parity difference (max_rate - min_rate), (3) disparate impact ratio (min_rate / max_rate). Flag any attribute where disparate impact ratio < 0.8 (the 80% rule used in US employment law). Also compute equalized odds: compare true positive rates and false positive rates across groups.
context.expert_knowledge: Fairness metrics: Demographic Parity Difference < 0.1 is acceptable, < 0.05 is ideal. Disparate Impact < 0.8 triggers regulatory scrutiny (4/5ths rule). Equalized Odds requires equal TPR and FPR across groups. Use Aequitas library or compute manually. Distinguish between individual and group fairness. Document which protected attributes show potential discrimination.
